## Context

This task adds `src/server/storage/cli_schema_dump.py` — a `dump_ddl()` that renders the full CREATE TABLE DDL from `Base.metadata` using SQLAlchemy's `create_mock_engine` (NO database connection), plus an argparse `main()` with `--ddl`/`--er`.
